name: Elrood
description: Elrood was a planet located between the Halbara and Kidron systems on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. It functioned as capital of the Elrood sector and as its major trade and manufacturing hub. Elrood headquartered Radell Mining Corporation, the largest company in the sector. It had two moons, Sharene and Lodos. The planet was named after Senator Elrood, who secured funding for its colonization.
